c = 1/9. I'm recalling this from the literature (the Balogh–Clemen–Lidický line of work on making K₅-free graphs bipartite, following Sudakov's K₄ result) rather than deriving it, and I'm not fully certain of the recalled value.

The one check I ran is consistent with it. The Ramsey–Turán number for K₅ with independence number o(n) is n²/4 edges. A max cut always keeps at least half the edges, so at most n²/8 edges need removing. The value 1/9 is below this bound, so it is plausible.

ANSWER: 1/9
